title: asplenium filix-femina var. pectinatum
intro: Asplenium filix-femina var. pectinatum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. It is known for its therapeutic properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lady fern include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Lady fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
